question: Ano ang mga hakbang at notices na ibinibigay ng Business Bureau bago tuluyang ipasara ang isang erring establishment?
answer:
The Business Bureau provides the following steps and notices before terminating an erring establishment, as stated in [S2] Business Bureau CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II.pdf | printed page 79 | chunk DEV120-BB-PDF0040-C001:

1. Conduct an inspection prior to the approval of the retirement application. [S2]
2. Request the client to sign in the logbook. [S3]

These steps are part of the process for termination of business, specifically under section 83(i) - Termination of Business in CTO Districts. [S2]

ground_truth: Non-compliant businesses receive a 1st Notice of Violation with an inspection report. If uncorrected after re-inspection within 15 days, a 2nd and Final Notice with Cease-and-Desist Order is recommended. Continued non-compliance results in a physical Closure Order within 1 day.
